correctness.rationale: From A^3=ab A the continuous-time unitary has only the A and A^2 spectral terms, yielding exactly five probability blocks depending on u=E cos(sqrt(ab)T) and v=E cos^2(sqrt(ab)T). The feasible moment region is -1<=u<=1, u^2<=v<=1, realizable by nonnegative observation times. The exact positive Hessian for n>=3 reduces the a,b>=2 case to v=u^2, and monotonicity of the cubic n^2 x^3+Kx+C yields the unique minimizing cosine or boundary x=-1. For star K_{1,m}, the global supporting-plane inequality and Hessian certify x=-(m-1)/(m+1). K_{1,2} uniquely needs u=0,v=1/3 and genuine time mixing; K_{1,1} is deterministic. The balanced H=r^2(r^2-6r+4) changes sign at integer r=6 and gives the stated cross-part-zero optimum. The independent exact matrix/gradient program was inspected but not independently executed; no finite test is substituted for these analytical inequalities.
